checkedAlternates.risk: Transactions are the subject of ACID.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A transaction is the operational unit (group-1), whereas atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability are its four ACID guarantees (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Primary keys automatically create an underlying index.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Primary key is a logical relational constraint (group-2), distinct from index data structures (group-3).
